EDUCATION.DISSTITLE: Towards Robust and Privacy-Aware Time Series Data Mining

SCHTEACH.TITLE: Data Mining & Warehouse
SCHTEACH.TECHMAT: I develop in-class hackathon-style assignments to enable students the ability to process real-world data. Students are expected to work in groups and submit the assignment in real-time.

SCHTEACH.TITLE: Mathematical Foundation of CS
SCHTEACH.TECHMAT: I introduce more materials to prepare for students on Artificial intelligence and machine learning. The goal is to stimulate interest for students in early stage and encourage students to pursue for AI direction and research. There will be some game activity and class activity in coding.
